title: CBOR content carrying a tag

source.note: composed: §7.1 lists String, Byte string, Array and Object as the CBOR content types, and a tag is none of them. Tag 0 says its text string is a date-time, meaning that JSON has no spelling for and that NLIP has no field for; stripping it would hand the application a value whose meaning had quietly changed. The bytes come from conformance/tools/cbor_encode.py with the `$tag` marker.

notes: The error is `cbor` — a codec-level failure — rather than a `wrong-type` against a field, because the value never becomes NLIP content at all. Bignum tags (2 and 3) are the exception: see 12-cbor-bignum-content.
